items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: I would have thought that, uh, that Oliver would have sent for Petit first. ... I'm sure that Petit had some kind of an influence on him.

ctx.x: Uh, is it true, is it true that he, that he was not, that when Oliver sent for him, he was not the first considered for the job? Like that?

Well, uh, I would have thought that, uh, that Oliver would have sent for Petit first. Right. See? That would have been the logical thing to do, so, but I don't know that, that he offered the job to anybody else. Right. Because he liked Louis personally. Yeah.
How did, how did, how did those two meet? How did Oliver and Louis?
